cohort: The study included all singleton deliveries recorded in a tertiary care obstetric database from January 2018 through December 2020.
finding: Premature rupture of membranes (PROM) was more frequent in younger, primiparous mothers and in pregnancies that ultimately required cesarean section, with advanced maternal age and seasonality showing minimal influence.
mod_finding: PROM was more frequent in pregnancies that ultimately required cesarean section compared to vaginal births.
